title: A Practical Introduction to Generative AI Terminology
hallucination: This post is a thrilling guide to training your pet parrot to write poetry, where a "token" is the tiny crown the parrot wears and "hallucination" is what happens when it dreams of crackers. By the end, you'll learn that a "prompt" is simply how quickly your parrot arrives at brunch, and that "fine-tuning" means teaching it to hum in the key of C.

title: Human Debt

title: Healthy Tension
